title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Local Peer Proof Harness Verification
verification_method: Focused local-loopback peer proof script, local cross-process sample peer proof script, aggregate HTTP/3 WebSocket xUnit test, sample client/server executable proof, stdout/stderr capture, artifact hashing, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers local-loopback and local cross-process peer proof for the already trace-owned RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 tunnel surface: Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong helper behavior, client ping/server pong behavior, fragmented or ordinary text exchange, buffered binary exchange, client close, and server close echo.
preconditions: Platform QUIC client and listener support are available locally.
The existing RFC 9220 unit and loopback requirement homes remain the source of detailed behavior coverage.
OpenSSL is available when generating cross-process throwaway TLS materials.
External WebSocket-over-H3 peer proof remains out of scope for these local peer artifacts.
expected_result: The local-loopback proof script, cross-process proof script, and aggregate test pass; the local-loopback manifest records one passed test; the cross-process manifest records a passed sample-client/sample-server exchange; artifact hashes are stable for the runs; SpecTrace validation accepts the artifacts; and diff hygiene is clean.
status_summary: The 2026-06-19 local-loopback peer proof passed one aggregate RFC 9220 WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 test. It covers Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong behavior, fragmented client text reassembly with an interleaved ping control frame and echoed pong, buffered 6000-byte binary exchange, client close, and server close echo. Local-loopback manifest SHA256: E6C5F362D53C119BB0581576B2ADC9C42ED5F92664C2500172AC4DAFBC13D648. Local-loopback report SHA256: 69554C34043D256D4B1F7C7CB95209FE0FE7C93FEA7DA1F9C4750431C859F692. Local-loopback TRX SHA256: 59727BEA72F6BCC973A0EE56E2112845BD4E7D0AA5FA2406D012D8CF08F2EC98. The 2026-06-19 local cross-process proof passed with the sample server process and sample client process communicating over HTTP/3 loopback. It covers Extended CONNECT setup, accepted metadata, server ping/client pong behavior, client ping/server pong echo, text echo, 6000-byte binary echo, client close, and server close echo. Cross-process manifest SHA256: 65DEBD2E802D69ECD9C9D53F86D2CEFA84DA66A5065C0893C6476B8059EA47B7. Cross-process report SHA256: B6E4069215DC8869B2795082AD0C42B7C48C1D3480E757E32202D5C6C64D5C72. Cross-process client-result SHA256: B1FFF220DC060674A3E61B1CFD270D94FA64F12A805D4E3B31E810AA9B5AB988. Evidence classes are local-loopback-peer and local-cross-process-peer; they are not external peer, isolated-host, publishable, or remote CI evidence.
